why: If the loop hazard is set by how self-similar the text so far is and by the T 0.6 sampler, not by a small set of loop units, then zeroing 1,000 attribution-ranked neurons leaves the history feedback in place and loops stay near the 71 of the unedited T 0.6 / top-p 1.0 cell.
Loops still lock under the low-temperature feedback, so cap hits stay near the unedited 98, which is mostly rule-A loops.

A fresh T 1.0 sample clears the self-similar history and T 1.0 never locks, so the 98 looped problems are solved at about the base's T 1.0 rate on long problems (~50%), on top of the 378 T 0.6 right answers.
